issue.title: Restore today's lost task links and guard the vault against silent task loss
issue.description: The task links lost on 2026-11-09 resolve again. A block-ID rename becomes one unit: a single undo either reverts it in every note or leaves no link dangling. payload.entry: Reproduced the split undo in real Obsidian 1.15 (athena, xvfb, scratch vault) with scripts/obsidian-block-id-rename-e2e.cjs against block-id-prompt 1.37.0: after the rename through the real modal, ONE vim `u` (and ONE editor.undo()) left bob.md ids ["new-id","old-id"] (task ^id reverted, same-note BLOCKS link still ^new-id) and daily/done notes on ^new-id: 3 dangling links, exactly the 2026-11-09 commit d6d6ba958 shape. That reproduction fully accounts for the observed state, so the stale-snapshot theory was not needed; I did not exhaustively audit the status-cycler/freshness/review-walk line writers beyond that.

Landed in bob-plugins (block-id-prompt 1.38.0): new fragments 155-block-rename-writes.js (one editor.transaction per open note, vault.process compare-and-swap per closed note, closed-note rollback) and 157-block-rename-follow.js (session record, 30 min window, undo/redo follow into recorded notes, ambiguity refusal + sticky Notice per decision undo_follows_rename = yes). Rename plan now carries the destination ^id edit in the destination note edit list. Real-Obsidian e2e passes 29/29 cases twice on 1.38.0 (vim u, editor.undo with the other note open in a split, redo, ambiguous note); unit tests in scripts/test-block-id-prompt-rename-atomic.cjs; npm test 5777 pass, npm run validate and docs:check green.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: other multi-edit gestures in block-id-prompt still apply a planned edit list as sequential editor.replaceRange calls, which keeps the same split-undo shape (task line + same-note link or Pomodoro link as separate undo events): applyTargetTaskPlan (140 source/targetEditor loops), completeTaskSourceLink (140, non-"((" path), 120-plugin-pomodoro-links.js (~682, ~835), 129-plugin-task-wikilink-pomodoro.js (~538), submitDirectBlockAdd (110) — apply each as one editor.transaction like 155-block-rename-writes.js does.

Deployed block-id-prompt 1.38.0 with bob plugins sync on apollo (~/bob) and on the Mac via ssh mac (main.js sha256 f0629939...89fd matches the repo build). Both stamps are source_head 77c34f1 with dirty=dirty because the commit lands after this turn (apollo synced from this workspace clone, the Mac from an rsync copy at /tmp/bob-plugins-j02); once the commit is on origin a bare bob plugins sync from each canonical checkout overwrites the stamp cleanly. Obsidian on the Mac must reload the plugin (or restart) to run 1.38.0.

Verified: real-Obsidian e2e reproduced the split undo on 1.37.0 and passes 29/29 (twice) on 1.38.0 (vim u, editor.undo, split-open note, redo, ambiguous-note sticky Notice); unit tests for single-transaction writes, closed-note compare-and-swap + rollback, undo/redo follow and ambiguity refusal pass; npm test (5777 pass), npm run validate and docs:check green; 1.38.0 deployed to apollo and the Mac (hash matches repo). Commit pending in bob-plugins.
